Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155v1) · human annotation: Reward-model data collection presents human labelers with 4 to 9 model responses to rank for a prompt.

candidate.paperfull.instructgpt.human-ranking-sets

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Pairwise comparisons derived from a single ranked set are correlated; they are not independent human judgements for each pair.
  • Training language models to follow instructions with human feedbackLocator: PDF p. 8; 3.5 Models / Reward modeling, second paragraph

    responses to rank

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155v1) · paper method: The paper’s prompt dataset primarily uses prompts submitted to early InstructGPT through the OpenAI API Playground.

candidate.paperfull.instructgpt.playground-prompts

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • The authors explicitly exclude production API customer data; labeler-written prompts bootstrap collection. This is the paper-described 2022 workflow.
  • Training language models to follow instructions with human feedbackLocator: PDF p. 6; 3.2 Dataset, first paragraph

    Playground interface

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155v1) · paper method: Most comparisons in this workflow are labelled by one contractor for cost reasons.

candidate.paperfull.instructgpt.single-contractor-comparisons

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • The authors identify repeated labelling as a possible improvement for detecting disagreements; this statement does not apply to every evaluation or all future InstructGPT collection.
  • Training language models to follow instructions with human feedbackLocator: PDF p. 19; 5.3 Limitations / Methodology, second paragraph

    only labeled by 1 contractor

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback (arXiv 2203.02155v1) · paper method: The PPO prompt dataset is used as RLHF input without per-prompt human labels.

candidate.paperfull.instructgpt.unlabelled-ppo-inputs

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • This concerns PPO input prompts. Human demonstrations and rankings are separate SFT and reward-model stages; the learned reward supplies PPO feedback.
  • Training language models to follow instructions with human feedbackLocator: PDF p. 7; 3.2 Dataset, paragraph beginning From these prompts

    without any human labels
